packageRules.description: Node's version in .nvmrc and the Dockerfile's base image as one pull request, so CI and production move together.
Dependabot owns GitHub Actions; see .github/dependabot.yml. Two bots on one ecosystem open a duplicate pull request for every bump.
The minor and patch tail as one pull request, merged once CI passes. Renovate merges it itself, since the repository has GitHub's auto-merge turned off. Its merge is a push, so the deploy follows.
